title: GRACE: Controlled Evidence Interventions for Diagnosing and Improving Knowledge Integration in GraphRAG
abstract: arXiv:2611.27350v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GraphRAG combines a language model's parametric knowledge with retrieved graph evidence, yet aggregate accuracy cannot show whether failures stem from missing paths, distractors, or conflicts with model knowledge. We introduce GRACE, a benchmark built by executing LC-QuAD 2.0 queries over Wikidata and applying four controlled interventions to each evidence subgraph: severing a support path, adding type-compatible distractors, attaching high-degree hubs, and replacing the supported answer with a counterfactual entity. Questions and option positions remain fixed across the five states. The validated benchmark contains 4,028 questions and 20,140 question-graph pairs. These comparisons reveal that question-only routing cannot distinguish evidence states, while relevance guidance can improve answerable states yet hurt when the support path is severed: relevant facts may not jointly suffice to answer. translated_title: GRACE：用于诊断与改进GraphRAG中知识整合的受控证据干预方法
translated_abstract: GraphRAG将语言模型的参数化知识与检索到的图谱证据相结合，然而总体准确率无法揭示失败究竟源于路径缺失、干扰项，还是与模型自身知识的冲突。我们提出GRACE基准，通过在Wikidata上执行LC-QuAD 2.0查询，并对每个证据子图施加四种受控干预来构建：切断支持路径、添加类型兼容的干扰项、附加高度数枢纽节点，以及用反事实实体替换被支持的答案。问题和选项位置在五种状态下保持固定。经过验证的基准包含4,028个问题和20,140个问题-图谱对。这些对比实验表明：仅基于问题的路由无法区分证据状态，而相关性引导虽能改善可回答的状态，却在支持路径被切断时造成损害——因为相关事实联合起来可能仍不足以回答问题。我们提出QCFSE-SA方法，它结合了类型化（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出GRACE基准，通过对证据子图施加切断支持路径、添加干扰项、附加高度数枢纽和反事实答案替换四种受控干预，来诊断GraphRAG知识整合失败的根源，并提出QCFSE-SA方法在不同证据状态下改进模型表现。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces GRACE, a benchmark that applies four controlled evidence interventions (severing support paths, adding type-compatible distractors, attaching high-degree hubs, and counterfactual answer replacement) to diagnose why GraphRAG fails at knowledge integration, and proposes QCFSE-SA to improve model performance across different evidence states.
